## History

During a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovered Fred Wright and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) together in the garden. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) subsequently confided in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and Fred had become engaged.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P6](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P7](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0007), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P9](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0009), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012), +12 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred is romantically involved with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and the two become engaged. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers them together in the garden, after which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide the news of their engagement.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +18 more_

- Romantically involved with — engaged to each other  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016), +2 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred works alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as a comrade and canvassing partner.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048)_
